_comment: Ground-truth calibration dataset for perception/visibility.py, graded by reading the 23 screenshots in win-mac-sync/from-windows/target acquisition screenshots/ directly (win-mac-sync/ is gitignored -- this fixture is the durable, versioned transcription of what those images show). See plans/vision-range-calibration/plan.md and body-layer/research/2026-09-17-vision-range-calibration.md for the full narrative. `object_type` values are the unit labels as displayed on the DCS F10 map for these screenshots, not verified raw LoGetWorldObjects `object_type` strings (no live probe/log was captured this session) -- see the research doc's 'object_type provenance' note for which entries this causes to fall through to object_model.DEFAULT_SIZE_M/DEFAULT_OP_CLASS today, including two (T-62, BMD1) the plan's own prose describes as correctly-sized that do not actually resolve given this transcription. Grade vocabulary: 'nothing' / 'marginal_speck' / 'speck_no_class' (presence achieved, class not) / 'class_recognizable' / 'type_recognizable'; null means that optic was not photographed at that range/bearing. Records are designed to accept new rows (closer range, longer range, other theatres/weather) without a format change -- see 'Capture request for Pass 2' in the plan.
